goal_text:
Fix the following problems in boltons, as described by contributors. Add or update tests for each fix.

### Render wrapped causes when no traceback was captured (boltons#562)

`ExceptionCauseMixin` captures a traceback only while handling its wrapped cause. Wrapping a stored exception outside that handler (or while handling an unrelated error) leaves `full_trace` unset, causing `str(error)` and `get_str()` to raise `AttributeError`. Treat the absent trace as empty and retain the existing cause/message formatting.

Validation: 3 new rendering regressions fail on master and pass with the fix, covering direct wrapping, chained wrapping, and an unrelated active exception. Full suite: 681 tests and 12 subtests pass.

The full test suite (python -m pytest -q --doctest-modules boltons tests) must stay green.
planner_notes: One indivisible fix in boltons/excutils.py plus a new test file tests/test_excutils.py (no existing excutils test file exists). No overlap concerns. Risk: other modules importing ExceptionCauseMixin (e.g. tbutils/docs) are unaffected, since only the absent-attribute case changes.

tasks.description: In boltons/excutils.py, make ExceptionCauseMixin render correctly when no traceback was captured. Currently full_trace is only set inside __new__ when the cause is the currently handled exception (or inherits full_trace from a wrapped cause), so otherwise str(err) and err.get_str() raise AttributeError in _get_trace_str (self.full_trace). Fix: add a class attribute `full_trace = None` on ExceptionCauseMixin (alternatively use getattr(self, 'full_trace', None) in _get_trace_str) so an absent trace is treated as empty. Keep existing formatting. Add new file tests/test_excutils.py with 3 regression tests: (1) direct wrapping of a stored exception outside any except block: `class MyErr(ExceptionCauseMixin): pass`; `e = MyErr(ValueError('boom'), 'msg')` -> str(e) == "msg (caused by ValueError('boom'))"-style output without raising, and get_str() does not raise and contains 'MyErr' and 'caused by' and 'ValueError'; (2) chained wrapping: wrap e in another MyErr outside a handler; str and get_str work and mention the root cause ValueError; (3) wrapping a stored exception while an unrelated exception is being handled (inside `except KeyError:`): str and get_str work, no 'Traceback' header. Run the full suite to confirm.
tasks.spec_ref: ExceptionCauseMixin (boltons/excutils.py): when a cause is supplied but no traceback was captured (cause not the active exception, no full_trace on cause), full_trace must be treated as empty. Then _get_trace_str returns '' so __str__ returns self._get_exc_str(incl_name=False), i.e. '<message> (caused by <RootCauseName: text>)' or ' caused by <RootCause>' if no message; get_str() returns '<ClassName>: <message> (caused by ...)' without a 'Traceback' header. No exception raised. Behavior when a trace is captured, or when there is no cause (str falls back to Exception.__str__), is unchanged.
